purpose: Define the evidence requirements for preserving an exact supported event-area geometry without converting it to a point or granting publication authority.

scope.current_lane: NYC Parks CEMS athletic facility recovery

parks_cems_required_evidence: exact parent park/property name plus borough resolving to one GISPROPNUM
exactly one recognized adjacent sport and field identifier pair
explicit applicable sport permitability flag on the official facility row
exactly one official Athletic Facilities SYSTEM row
official SYSTEM used by exactly one strict source claim
canonical SHA-256 of the preserved source geometry
prohibited_transformations: polygon centroid used as exact event point
representative point generated from facility geometry
parent park centroid substituted for facility geometry
geometry simplification that changes source-site identity without a separately reviewed contract
merging distinct source claims solely because the official geometry is coarser

publication_boundary.contract_conformant_entry_meaning: The entry is suitable for retention as non-public exact-area evidence only.
publication_boundary.future_requirement: Any public area rendering requires a separately reviewed area-geometry schema, renderer contract, corpus QA, and release decision.
